messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — prepping Acadia QBR for next Thurs 9am PT. Need exec one-pager + full deck. Who can own slides + demo?
Alejandro Ruiz: I can own product metrics + adoption slides. Will pull 30d usage and any latency regressions.
Sophie Chen: I'll take onboarding & health (completion rates, blocker list). Will pull the onboarding checklist and current open items.
Ben Howard: I'll draft the renewal risk slide — NPS, contract timeline, cost concerns. Need the latest contract ETA from @Liz Park.
Liz Park: Ack — contract in legal review, expect sign by 4/20. I'll add a timeline entry into the deck folder.
Amanda Liu: I'll own the demo and runbook. Need a stable model version to pin and the test prompt set. @Maya can you confirm model choice?
Maya Patel: Pin demo to rdx-open-7b-v2 and fallback to rdx-quant-7b if latency spikes. I'll upload the prompt file to the shared drive tonight.
qbr-bot: Reminder: final slides due Tue 12pm PT. Auto-check will validate filenames: slides/Acadia_QBR_v*.pdf
Sophie Chen: :thumbsup: I'll capture customer feedback bullets in the exec one-pager. Quick ask — does anyone have the last EBR notes handy?
Alejandro Ruiz: Link: https://drive.redwood/ebr/acadia/notes — see sections 'integration latency' and 'billing confusion'.
Ben Howard: For renewal risk, top 2 flags: 1) billing surprises, 2) latency spikes during peak. Suggested mitigations: a) joint billing review with acct team, b) trial of Dedicated slot reservation.
Maya Patel: Let's convert mitigations into JIRA tasks. I'll create tickets for the billing review and slot-reservation trial and tag @finance and @eng-oncall.
Amanda Liu: Test prompts uploaded: https://drive.redwood/qbr/acadia/prompts.txt. Running smoke tests tomorrow 10am PT and will ping @Sophie for demo choreography.
Sophie Chen: Got it — I'll coordinate the demo run and ensure we have fallback script if model flakiness shows up.
Alejandro Ruiz: Adding cost vs. throughput graph to slide 4 (metrics dashboard export). Will attach before EOD Mon.
Liz Park: Contract timeline + renewal cadence added to slide 2. Also put in the legal note about invoicing cadence.
Maya Patel: Deliverable checklist (add to slide folder):
```
- Exec one-pager (owner: Maya)
- Product metrics slides (owner: Alejandro)
- Onboarding & health slide (owner: Sophie)
- Renewal risk + mitigation slide (owner: Ben)
- Demo + runbook (owner: Amanda)
- Slides uploaded as PDF by Tue 12pm PT
- JIRA tickets for mitigations created and linked
- Smoke test report attached to demo slide
```
Ben Howard: Proposed owner roll call: Product @Alejandro, Onboarding @Sophie, Renewal @Ben, Demo @Amanda, Exec sync @Maya — agree?
Alejandro Ruiz: Agree.
Sophie Chen: Yep.
Amanda Liu: Confirmed.
Liz Park: Confirmed from legal side.
Maya Patel: Timeline summary:
- Mon EOD: Product attaches graphs, Sophie uploads onboarding bullets, Ben drafts risk slide
- Tue 12pm PT: final PDFs in folder (qbr-bot will validate)
- Wed 10am PT: dry run w/ demo owner + exec run-through
- Thu 9am PT: QBR with customer execs
Maya Patel: Any blockers not mentioned? If none, I'll create the JIRA tasks and a shared calendar invite.
Ben Howard: No blockers from me — will finish draft by Mon morning.
Sophie Chen: No blockers.
Amanda Liu: I'll confirm smoke test results after run tomorrow.
qbr-bot: Slide upload reminder set for Tue 12pm PT.
